name: Wizualny edytor GRUB
description: Reads /etc/default/grub (world-readable, unprivileged) and manages named presets + dropped-in themes locally (~/.local/share/posma/grub-presets, unprivileged). Writing the real config, installing a theme into /boot/grub/themes, reading grub.cfg's boot-entry list, and restoring a backup all go through the privileged broker, which backs up + rotates + auto-rolls-back on a failed update-grub — never a raw unguarded write
